Need PDI.
We need MemoryBandwidth path for https://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/blob/master/yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Metric/Value.interface.yaml

You changed how the long-running response is unpacked (now reads both uint32_t fields instead of just the first). 
Worth calling this out explicitly in the commit message so git log can find it.

nit: The class is now publishing two metrics (processor + memory) on two different inventory associations, but the name still implies a single utilization. Worth considering a rename like NvidiaGpuUtilizationMetrics,
or splitting into two classes — though both come from the same NSM cmd,
so a single class is also defensible.

Could you refactoring to use the NvidiaGpuLongRunningCommand helper proposed in
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/90492 once it lands.
Thanks!
I think we can rename "Current Utilization" to "Processor Bandwidth" here (and Line 76) for symmetry with the Memory Bandwidth logs.

Should we use `sdbusplus::object_path` type here for symmetry?
And I see "_DRAM_0" is hardcoded in NvidiaGpuDevice.cpp:108 too. Can we use it here?
I think we should rename here. Maybe "GPU Utilization Metrics" or similar.

We have overload decodeGetCurrentUtilizationModeResponse at NvidiaGpuMctpVdm.cpp.
Could you add a 2-uint32 overload, use it here, and update the
tests?
Please keep this file and NvidiaGpuCurrentUtilization.cpp on the same template.
Thanks.
Please add the unit case for the long-running overload.
The long-running overload is already unit-tested in test_NvidiaGpuSensorTest.cpp
